justification: Inspected [src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/monitor/FileAlterationListener.java](/data/henrique/detecting_smells_study/codex/data/repositories/apache/commons-io/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/monitor/FileAlterationListener.java), which is a small interface with 8 event-callback methods and no fields or implementation logic. All methods are cohesive filesystem-monitoring callbacks (create/change/delete for files and directories, plus start/stop), and [src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/monitor/FileAlterationListenerAdaptor.java](/data/henrique/detecting_smells_study/codex/data/repositories/apache/commons-io/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/monitor/FileAlterationListenerAdaptor.java) shows the expected one-method-per-event adapter, confirming this is an intentionally narrow listener contract rather than a class needing decomposition.
